population: English-speaking Canadian adults age 18+ with internet access; opt-in incentivized consumer panel

Print.measure: Fiction genres read in physical/print books

Audiobook.measure: Fiction genres listened to in audiobooks

Print.measure: Non-fiction subjects read in physical/print books

Audiobook.measure: Non-fiction subjects listened to in audiobooks

selection_rule: Up to three selections for every genre question; overlapping choices, not shares of a mutually exclusive whole
denominator: Reported as fiction or nonfiction readers within each format. Exact respondent routing and eligible subgroup counts are not published. Do not use 1,005 as genre n.
recall_period: Previous year (2025); inherited format-specific book-reading context

missing_cells.interpretation: Not offered by Q55; missing, never zero
Not offered by Q56; missing, never zero

comparison_restriction: Separate-panel descriptive results; preserve year and genre_scope. No significance tests or CIs from exact subgroup n because it is unpublished. Do not average with Singapore mixed-material genres.
baseline_rule: Append to genre history only; preserve all original 2024 Canada rows and 2024 default/selection explicitly.
